description: Review AI for one app in one storefront: a summary of the recent reviews and the themes in them — complaints, requests, praise — each with the reviews quoted as evidence. The same day and the same review batch return the stored summary at no allowance; a new summary uses one Review AI credit from the monthly allowance (every plan; Free has a taste). Answers `state: "too_few"` with the count while there are too few reviews to summarise.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: summarize_reviews
